selection: One configuration for all three seeds, minimizing mean validation joint NLL. Never pick seeds.
stage1: p50 resumes exact last checkpoint after epoch50 in a separate directory; p75/p90 train from same seeded initialization, same original schedule, up to150 epochs.
stage2: Best stage1 configuration by mean validation joint NLL; each seed branches from its own best weights. Compare lambda0/0.05/0.1 for50 epochs, all with same new Adam1e-4. Lambda0 is a matched continuation control.
contrast: hinge(0.1+correct_conditional_NLL-wrong_conditional_NLL), mean per11tokens. Wrong profiles preserve exact target value and swap competitors from cyclic neighbors within16-sample target-activity bins. Synthetic counterfactuals, not measured labels.
stage3: Validation-only temperature NLL sweep, all18targets, report all temperatures and select one shared temperature by mean joint NLL. Training remains float32; no PRISM guidance in these stages.
test_policy: No test arrays or previous test result files opened by optimization. Old test is already exposed; any later test comparison is retrospective, not new independent confirmation.
original_results: Never overwrite checkpoints/G2, previous evaluations, main report or supply.
